column3: Manami Route ・ Rebuilding a Relationship
Muu..
Manami's in a bad mood and is pouting...
Should I play along a little?
No, but... It's not my fault at all to begin with...
Sorry, I'm cranky when I'm getting up. I said too much.
Th-That's not true...
It's my fault for surprising you so early in the morning. I'm sorry.
Phew, for now it seems like Manami's mood is back to normal.
Although...!
A childhood friend that comes to wake you up in the morning; what kind of parallel universe is this?!
It can't be... Did my body unknowingly dive into the galge world...?!
That expression... It's no good after all..
No, it's not that it didn't work, but... How do I say this...? I was just surprised.
Ah!  By the way, is the injury from yesterday all right?
Yup! Thanks for your concern. It was shallow and is healing just fine!
I-Is that so... Well, that's fine then ...
Also... Fufufu...
W-What now?
Nope, nothiiing!
Well then, it's time for you to get up. I'll be waiting outside.
Y-Yeah.
Ah!  You can't go back to sleep either!
I'll be fine!
Ah, Manami!
Hm? What is it?
Um... Thanks for coming by to wake me up.
You're welcome!
...Haa
No way... I had no idea it would turn out like this.
How did this even happen...?!
No, that has to be it, since I raised the event flag so easily.
Since my girlfriend is my childhood friend, this is a situation that was bound to happen. So this means from now on, she's going to wake me up every day...
Kyouu-chaan. You ready?
Aah!  ...C-Coming!
Hm?
Oh crap! She was also home! By the looks of it, she's pissed..
Without a doubt, that's because Manami's here... I think.
Err.. Kirino?  About Manami, I'd like to say that she came without aski--
Trying to brag about this 【galge】-like situation?
It's sad that we ended up having the same idea.
Sad about what?
No, never mind.
In any case, did you say thanks to Manami about yesterday?
...That's none of your business.
None of my business? She was hurt back there.
Shut up. Aren't you getting carried away after a wake-up call from your childhood friend?
No.. It's not that I'm getting carried away, but...
Also, what happened with you and her?
That's...
Can I honestly say she's my childhood friend...?
But there's no other way to put it.
No, wait, yesterday Manami and I started dating...
Though, for some reason Kirino gets angry as soon as Manami is mentioned. And thirty percent more unreasonable than normal.  If I don't carefully watch
my behavior here, it'll obviously end up being a bothersome situation.
Hmmmnnn, what should I do...?
My girlfriend... I guess.
Like I said, my girlfriend.
G-Girlfriend? That girl? Since when?
Hmm...
Why aren't you answering...?
No, well...
Ah! I get it, it's the punchline! That's riiight, that has to be it. Same with that hand holding yesterday too, right?!
But honestly, your joke isn't making me laugh, so stop it, okay?
That's not what I'm trying to do though...
...You're saying it's not a lie?
If I lied about it, how would you react?!
...What about my life counseling?
I'll manage that separately.
Ah, I see! Understood! Do whatever you want!!
Eh?  Did I say something wrong?
Not really... With someone like you, I was just thinking that this plain girl is a perfect match!
...Oh. So you're saying that you accept our relationship? Thanks!
...Urgh!! What's up with you! No one said that! Disgusting! You're the worst!!
Ah! Hey, Kirino!
What's wrong with that girl...?
Err.. Childhood friends?
What is it?
I was thinking, that's all you've got in the end.
What's that supposed to mean?
Nothing. When it's like this, I feel kinda sorry for that plain girl.
Huh?  That doesn't make any sense!
If you can't understand, then why not just stay that way?
...What the hell?  You're the one who asked.
There's no problem with me asking you anything, is there?
You...
Out of my way. I'm heading off to school.
It sounds so lively, Kyou-chan... Have you finished getting ready?
Ah, yes, just now.
Still flirting with that plain girl, huh? Disgusting.
Hey, don't be like that. Hurry up and go to school.
Shut up! I'd go even if you didn't tell me to!
...Really, can't you shut it with the screaming first thing in the morning?
You're the one making all the noise! You get woken up by your childhood friend, and then it's like whatever!
Y-You two? Let's get going to school, okay?
